title: Composition Run Telemetry Record
description: One JSONL record per composition run. Stored at .run/telemetry/compose-runs.jsonl. Retention: 90 days per sprint.md §Telemetry.

schema_version.description: Schema version sentinel for forward compatibility.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of run completion.

composition_path.description: Relative path to composition YAML from repo root.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome of the full composition run.

stage_count.description: Number of stages in the composition.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the full run in milliseconds.

iteration_mode.description: Iteration mode used (null if no iterate: blocks).

persistent_state_used.description: True if any stage used mode: persistent.

audit_signed.description: True if audit_signed: true was set on the composition.

error_code.description: Structured error code on non-success outcome, e.g. [STREAM-NO-PRODUCER].

error_stage.description: Stage number where the first error occurred.

git_sha.description: HEAD commit SHA at run time for provenance.
